title: Dev Proxy RewritePlugin rewrite rules
description: Rewrite rules for the Dev Proxy RewritePlugin

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON schema used to validate this rewrite rules file.

rewrites.description: Array of rewrite rule objects that define the list of rewrite rules the RewritePlugin applies.

in.description: Pattern to match the incoming request.

url.description: Regular expression to match the incoming request URL.

URL to rewrite the request to. Can use capture groups from the 'in' pattern and reference environment variables using ${env:VAR_NAME}. Environment variable values are inserted as-is, so they can also reference capture groups. If a referenced environment variable isn't set, the rule is skipped. If omitted, the request URL isn't changed.

headers.description: Request headers to set on requests matching the 'in' URL. Replaces the value of an existing header (matched case-insensitively) or adds the header if it's missing.

value.description: Value to set for the request header. Can reference environment variables using ${env:VAR_NAME}. If a referenced environment variable isn't set, the rule is skipped.
